# Paths the environment owns. This is a documented allow-list, not a mechanical check (not enforced in env-v1).
# Anything NOT matched here is attempt territory: attempts may add and change those files freely,
# and the environment never touches them. Attempts do not edit the paths below; they ask for an env change instead.
#
# One pattern per line, relative to the repository root, forward slashes.
# "*" matches within one path segment; "**" matches any number of segments (including none).
# Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are comments.
compose.yaml
env/**
tools/**
docs/env/**
.github/workflows/env-*.yml
